# Grayling Fuels - berth loading journal

Nightly export from the berth controllers at the Grayling terminal. The
accounting export retried after a link drop, so some lines were written to
the journal twice.

One line per state change:

    <UTC time> BAY <bay> tanker=<id> LOAD START
    <UTC time> BAY <bay> tanker=<id> PUMP ON | PUMP OFF
    <UTC time> BAY <bay> tanker=<id> METER litres=<n>
    <UTC time> BAY <bay> tanker=<id> LOAD COMPLETE litres=<n>

A tanker is loaded at one berth only and loads once per run.
